==='''Towers of Midnight Book Tour, Barnes and Noble, Sacramento, CA 2 November 2010'''===

'''''Report by Frenzy'''''



Just got back from the Sacramento booksigning. He're the fun stuff:

1) 300+ people at the signing. We got there about 2 hours early, and were 41 & 42 in line.

2) Brandon recognized JWB and I as Theorylanders, and asked if we saw him in his TL shirt.

3) JWB got your book signed, TankSpill

4) Three people signed my book: Brandon, Harriet, and Jason from Dragonmount. Jason specifically asked for my book, and signed it, "I will <u>never</u> yeild the Jordan Con stage again!!"

Now, back to the book and many of my theories dying miserable deaths...
